text: Why does he think he can speak against the armies of the living God?
I, your servant, will go and fight this Philistine!
The Lord saved me from a lion and a bear. He will also save me from this Philistine.
I can't go in this. I'm not used to it.
You come to me using a sword, a large spear, and a small spear. But I come to you in the name of the Lord of heaven's armies. He's the God of the armies of Israel! You have spoken out against him.
